hv9jfbgm9.name: Arvin
hv9jfbgm9.visualAnchor: Middle-aged man with a sharply angular, weathered face, deeply tanned olive skin, short steel-gray hair, heavy-lidded dark amber eyes, broad utilitarian build, and a pale synthetic graft across the back of his left hand. Navy/slate field clothing, fire-retardant canvas trousers, rolled thermal henley, utility harness, reinforced work boots.
hv9jfbgm9.voiceProfile: Calibrated staccato cadence, technical and data-dense; zero verbal fillers. Under stress the rhythm fractures into short, jagged phrases.

5snrx2won.name: Milo
5snrx2won.visualAnchor: Compact, energetic young man with desert-clay skin, a round youthful face, and a wild mane of tight black curls. Safety-orange and dark practical workwear with rugged field modifications.
5snrx2won.voiceProfile: Fast, enthusiastic and intuitive; interrupts easily and talks about machinery as if it were alive.

8tg8ibh7z.name: Lucia
8tg8ibh7z.visualAnchor: Athletic woman with fair skin, dark razor-cut hair, high cheekbones, a skeptical brow and a clinical unblinking gaze. Camel, charcoal and bone palette; sharply tailored dust-resistant field clothing and polished black combat boots.
8tg8ibh7z.voiceProfile: Smoke-edged contralto with measured, low-decibel authority; deliberate silence controls the rhythm of conversations.

dljv31xue.name: Cyrus
dljv31xue.visualAnchor: Broad-shouldered older man with silvered hair, weathered skin and pale piercing blue eyes. Architectural Aegis command silhouette in obsidian, chrome and white with heavy matte-black tactical boots.
dljv31xue.voiceProfile: Deep, resonant and calm; short declarative sentences delivered with official certainty.
